title: Independently review the writing-aware version-effort study against the live goal and later evidence
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Independently review docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.{md,json} against the current full goal, including writing and save-version preservation, and assess whether the named later evidence changes its conclusions or its next-step recommendation. Expected gain: a pinned Standards/Spec CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR disposition that closes this bounded compatibility-estimate review or identifies exact corrections. This recovers the unexecuted 0131 review; it is not a new estimate. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Inspect .session/exports/manifest.json first and identify the explicitly exported #501 report; report unavailable exports honestly rather than inventing report contents. Pin starting commit/tree and the exact study bytes, distinguishing current-file pins from historical provenance.
- [ ] Review goal/goal.md against the study's claimed scope. The 0132 shaper read the complete committed goal and live goal.text and observed matching requirements; record that as shaper-provided parity evidence, not your own independent live-state check. If .session/loop-state.json is staged, compare it directly; its absence alone must not require a continuation. Check creation, modification, source rebuilds, artifact-family coverage, original save version versus emitted format versus validation runtime, and the all-version/2024 comparison. Explain any live-goal mismatch.
- [ ] Audit the eight cost drivers, inherited reading estimates, assumptions and missing measurements using targeted source locators from the evidence JSON. Determine whether totals, ratios or a fallback decision are justified; do not invent ranges or treat unknown costs as zero.
- [ ] Assess the effect of 0100 WM1 version declarations, the 0109 project-text proposal and current writing-method coverage, and saved POC pair/edit-readiness evidence on 0099 conclusions and its already-completed WM1 follow-up. Identify historical context separately from any presently misleading recommendation. Do not reopen the closed WM1/WP1/pair reviews or rerun their probes.
- [ ] Save a detailed pinned findings ledger in .session/artifacts/writing-estimate-review-0132.json, with evidence locators, severity, Standards/Spec dispositions and the smallest justified next step. Put the usable verdict and unresolved limitations in .session/report.md. Reviewer writes no repository files and does not amend the study.
- [ ] Preserve unknown native validity, semantic encoding, timing/strata and version-authority evidence. Neither human C1 request #618 nor Save As control request #532 is answered by this review; do not duplicate or await either. Passing this review is not benchmark readiness, method acceptance, product success or a 2024 selection.
## Verification
python3 -c "import hashlib,json,pathlib; pins={'docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.md':'e444c54a1cdc1f96b55735ef4ca2b06ea6e011087b6fb84e3ed3ea16b0477882','docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.json':'992a3b22a690e917a1f144e32adaaa7d8d52ed7afe9223105cfe45746bcb31c4'}; assert all(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in pins.items()); assert isinstance(json.loads(pathlib.Path('docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.json').read_text()),dict); print('reviewed study identity and JSON: OK')"
This repository-only command verifies input identity, not the review verdict. Semantic findings and artifact identity belong in the report; the engine cannot read session artifacts.
## Context
- docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.md and .json: existing writing-aware study, not a reading-only estimate; #501 reports its live-goal comparison was unavailable.
- Exported #501 report: original scope, limitations and historical output pins.
- docs/research/0100-wm1-version-evidence.md and .json: completed single-original declaration audit, explicitly without independent save-version authority.
- benchmark/project-text-writing-0109.md and .json: narrow project-text preparation separates byte correctness from native/version validity; compare its historical proposal with current method rather than treating it as a new trial.
- docs/research/poc/delivery.md, docs/research/poc/edit-readiness.md and docs/research/poc/pair/constant-rules-0106.md: saved negative delivery and later bounded evidence; inspect availability and pins, no renewed edit attempt.
## Budget
Read .session/exports/manifest.json, exported #501 report, goal/goal.md, docs/perpetua/evaluation.md, the two 0099 files, the two 0100 files, the two 0109 files, benchmark/writing/method.json targeted coverage/version fields, and the three named POC Markdown files. The live .session/loop-state.json is optional, since the engine normally supplies it only to the shaper and Policymaker; if available read only goal and owner-request sections. If a named path is unavailable, report that boundary once. Use targeted fields/locators for large JSON; no whole large ledgers. Read at most eight additional source sections explicitly linked by 0099 JSON when needed to substantiate a finding; name them in the ledger. Keep command output short. No corpus searches, old checker replays, benchmark/native execution, product changes, owner requests or duplicate effort study. Report a blocking pin mismatch early. Preserve partial findings and exact remaining checks if the session cannot finish.
